reason: UL listing number is shown, shipping is 3 to 5 days, and returns are free, so I can order one for the living room and my electrician won't balk. If it looks right when it arrives, I'll order more for the other rooms.
objection: I've never heard of this store and 60 reviews is thin. I'd check that the UL number is real, and I don't want to be stuck with a hassle return when my electrician is already booked.
would_change_my_mind: If the UL number didn't check out on UL's database, or if the return label turned out not to be really free.
